SELECT id, user_id, notebook_id, folder_id, title, LEFT(content_md, 200) AS excerpt, word_count, is_pinned AS pinned, created_at, updated_at FROM note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND notebook_id = #{notebookId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
AND folder_id = #{folderId}
AND (title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content_md ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, updated_at DESC
